name: Event attendee follow-up list
summary: The day after a webinar, open day, workshop or customer event, the organiser gets the follow-up list from the registration and attendance exports: who came, who missed it, who cancelled and who walked in, with counts that tie, a drafted note per group, and everyone left out and why.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own brief for the day-after work on an event, and its own method for turning an event's registration and attendance exports into a checked follow-up list with drafted notes.
